# Fanning out over a folder the store picked

A node claims a pick-policy selector and expands the picked folder's contents
into partitions. The template names no file: the author does not enumerate the
folder upstream.

## Configure a pick policy

```yaml
root: /workspace
host: 127.0.0.1
grpc_port: 9200
http_port: 9210
sweep_interval_seconds: 60
pick_policies:
  "@batches":
    root: "batches"
    on_commit: recycle
    on_give_up: recycle
    visibility_timeout_seconds: 60
    sync_strategy: on_open
```

With a workspace holding two candidate folders under `batches/`, each seeded
with three `.txt` files and one `.md` file.

## The template

```yaml
name: expand-folder-demo
version: "1"
nodes:
  - type: per-file
    executor: verifier-http
    claim_producers:
      - name: claim-producer-filesystem
        selector: "@batches"
        intent: rw
        alias: folder
    error_types:
      "acquire/unavailable": {action: give_up}
    fan_out:
      claim: folder
      partition_request: '{"expand_folder": {"filter": "*.txt"}}'
      parallelism: 3
      error_policy:
        kind: best_effort
    attributes:
      schema:
        type: object
        properties:
          url:
            type: string
            source: "http://endpoint:8000/{{child.partition_key}}"
```

## Drive it

```bash
curl -sS -X POST "$BASE/v1/instances/$IID/messages" \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" -d '{}'

curl -sS "$BASE/v1/observability/claim-handles?instance_id=$IID"
rimsky instance nodes "$IID" --endpoint "$BASE" -o json
```

## What the product does

The producer opens exactly one parent claim, on one of the two candidate folders
— the pick policy chooses.

The split returns three sub-scopes, keyed by that folder's three `.txt` file
names. The `.md` file in the same folder produces no sub-claim, and no file of
the folder that was not picked appears anywhere in the run: the filter and the
pick both bind.

The parent and all three work units settle fresh. Each work unit resolves
`{{child.partition_key}}` into its own URL, so each reaches its own file's path.

With `parallelism: 3`, the three work units run at the same time.
